Hulleman, C. S., Godes, O., Hendricks, B. L., & Harackiewicz, J. M. (2010) Enhancing interest and performance with a utility value intervention

A.reason: The source's title is 'Making Connections: Replicating and Extending the Utility Value Intervention in the Classroom'. Its Study 2 tests the utility-value writing intervention and finds a larger benefit for students with low initial exam scores (the Exam x UV contrast). That is the core finding of the Hulleman & Harackiewicz (2009) utility-value intervention. The source does not name this reference, so the identification rests on the title and design.
